services.name: TWIMC Certificate
services.description: This service enables users to obtain an official certificate that outlines the facts and circumstances recorded in reports of damage, natural disasters, or traffic accidents. The certificate specifies the status of the parties involved and the resulting damages, enabling users to complete the necessary legal procedures with relevant entities such as judicial authorities and insurance companies.

services.name: TWIMC Inmate Certificate
services.description: This service aims to enable the inmate, their sponsor, or a family member (upon the inmate’s approval) to obtain an official “To Whom It May Concern” certificate confirming the completion or ongoing execution of the judicial sentence in Dubai’s correctional and penal institutions. The certificate is valid for a period of time, facilitating the completion of official, financial, and social transactions in accordance with applicable regulations.

services.name: Traffic Clearance Certificate
services.description: This service enables users to obtain a clearance certificate confirming that the vehicle owner has settled all traffic violations and that there are no recorded accidents, traffic points, or active restrictions in Dubai against the vehicle or the driver’s license.

services.name: Traffic Status Certificate
services.description: This service enables users to obtain a certificate detailing the vehicle’s traffic record, including fines, black points, and registered accidents, along with the driver’s involvement in each.

groups.name: Pay Traffic Fines
groups.description: Manage and pay traffic violations on your vehicle or license

services.name: Fines Inquiry and Payment
services.description: A service to inquire about traffic violations, including the following: • Traffic Fines Payment : A service that enables the settlement of traffic violations registered against a vehicle plate, driving licence, or traffic code. • Traffic Fines Instalments : A service that allows for the payment of traffic violations in monthly instalments via direct debit or credit card, subject to applicable terms and conditions. • Pay Against Impound : A service that allows for the payment of a daily fee to waive a vehicle’s impoundment period, provided no legal restrictions apply. • Smart Impound : A service that allows a vehicle to be kept at a designated private location during an impoundment period using a smart device linked to the operations centre, with movement permitted only in emergencies. • Black Points Transfer : A service that enables the transfer of black points from a vehicle’s record to a driver’s record, thereby allowing the fine to be settled. • Violation Review : A service that allows for a formal request to review a traffic violation and reassess the accuracy of the recorded details. • Violation Evidence Images : A service that enables the viewing of radar-captured images provided as evidence for traffic violations issued against their record. • Traffic Fines Statement Dispatch : A service that enables the provision of a comprehensive statement of traffic violations to a specified email address.

services.name: Gold Trade Security Audit
services.description: This service enables gold traders to submit security verification requests for gold purchase transactions, to ensure that the gold being sold is not linked to any criminal cases or offenses.

services.name: Events Security
services.description: This service allows government authorities or the businesses to request police presence at their events to ensure effectiveness by providing all security procedures and facilitating traffic, preventive measures and security and safety procedures.

services.description: This service aims to enable drivers holding driving licenses issued from Dubai, and who have accumulated traffic points on their licenses to enroll in specialized traffic safety training courses to benefit from a reduction in the points recorded against them.

services.name: Drug Awareness Lecture
services.description: This service aims to enable organizations involved in drug control to meet their needs by conducting training courses or organizing specialized field workshops on drug control.

services.name: Student Awareness
services.description: This service enables educational institutions to request awareness programs for students, delivered by specialists from Dubai Police, to enhance their security and social awareness.

services.name: Public Lecture
services.description: This service discusses the most critical issues, challenges and developments in drug control. It examines the topic from multiple perspectives with a team of specialists, aiming to develop solutions and recommendations for these concerns.

groups.name: OCEC

services.name: Neighborhood Police
services.description: This service aims to strengthen community policing by enabling residents to communicate directly with police officers through an interactive neighborhood platform, report concerns and suggestions, and collaborate in addressing local issues, thereby enhancing security, safety, and quality of life within the community.

services.name: Police Eye
services.description: This service enables users to provide security or sensitive information and report any activities or incidents suspected of posing a threat to public safety and community security

services.description: This service enables members of the community, whether Dubai Police employees or the public, to volunteer with Dubai Police by registering for available opportunities on the Dubai Police Volunteer Platform.

services.name: Request Dubai Police Activities
services.description: This service enables individuals, entities, and organizations to request the participation of Dubai Police specialized units, such as the Mounted Police, Music Band, K9 Unit, and Luxury Patrols in official events, festivals, and public parades held across the Emirate of Dubai.

groups.name: DP Personnel Welfare and Support
groups.description: A medical and social care service for Dubai Police's employees

services.name: Medical Treatment Extension
services.description: This service enables health authorities and medical centers to submit requests for extending the treatment period of Dubai Police patients receiving medical care abroad, ensuring the continuity of care in accordance with approved medical reports and recommendations.

services.name: Retirees Support
services.description: This service enables Dubai Police retirees to access a comprehensive package of dedicated services designed to strengthen communication and facilitate their access to various benefits. The services include the issuance and renewal of military and civil identification cards, issuance and renewal of the “Esaad” card, military health insurance, medical treatment and equipment requests, issuance of different types of service certificates, and home visit arrangements for senior citizens and individuals unable to attend in person.

groups.name: Request to Contact The Police
groups.description: Connect with DP leadership or relevant specialists in related fields

services.name: Contact Police Scientists Council
services.description: This service allows users to submit a request to hire a lecturer or request to give a lecture with the help of a lecturer from Dubai Police.

services.name: DP Leaders At Your Service
services.description: This service aims to enhance direct communication between Dubai Police senior leadership and the public, allowing leaders to respond to inquiries and feedback within their functional and administrative responsibilities

groups.name: Apply for a Job
groups.description: A service enables job seekers to apply to vacancies at Dubai Police

services.name: Job Seekers
services.description: A service through which job seekers can learn about vacancies in Dubai Police and apply accordingly.

groups.name: Support and Emergency Response
groups.description: A Service to request immediate support from specialized teams

services.name: Smart Home Security
services.description: This service aims to enhance home security in Dubai through a smart monitoring system that operates 24/7, connected with the strategic partner “e& (Etisalat)” to provide instant alerts supported by a unified cellular network.

services.name: Child Protection
services.description: This service aims to provide an immediate and comprehensive response to cases involving children exposed to any form of physical or psychological abuse or neglect, by offering the necessary protection and support to ensure their safety and safeguard their rights in accordance with applicable laws.

services.name: Women Protection
services.description: This service aims to protect and support women at risk of, or experiencing, psychological or physical violence, neglect, or rights violations, ensuring their legal, social, and human rights are fully safeguarded. It is delivered by the Women’s Protection Section under the Child and Women's Protection Department, a dedicated unit offering support, guidance, and comprehensive investigations into all forms of violence against women.

services.name: People of Determination Support
services.description: This service aims to enable People of Determination with physical, hearing, or visual disabilities across all Emirates to register and subscribe, ensuring they granted priority in ambulance dispatch and provided with a fast and appropriate response in emergency situations.

services.name: Worker’s Voice
services.description: This service aims to enable workers in the business sector to submit individual or collective complaints against the companies or institutions they work for, related to wages, working conditions, labor accommodation, or health and safety requirement.

services.name: Critical Care Response
services.description: This service aims to enable heart patients and those with critical medical conditions in the Emirate of Dubai to register for priority ambulance dispatch and receive prompt and appropriate medical attention in case of an emergency.

services.name: Tourists Support
services.description: This service provides dedicated support to tourists visiting Dubai's Emirate by receiving and addressing tourism-related inquiries, reports, and complaints. As it ensures guidance, coordination, and assistance through official Dubai Police channels to help maintain a safe and positive tourism experience.

services.name: Provide Care for Human Trafficking Victims
services.description: This service enables individuals to report suspected cases or practices related to human trafficking such as labor exploitation, sexual exploitation, or organ trafficking. It also aims to protect the privacy of individuals and ensure that information reaches the competent authorities in a secure and safe manner.
